author: Sirunyan, Albert M and others
title: Measurement of properties of $B_s^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ decays and search for $B^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ with the CMS experiment
abstract: Results are reported for the $B_s^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ branching fraction and effective lifetime and from a search for the decay $B^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$. The analysis is based on data collected with the CMS detector in 2016-2018 corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 140 fb$^{-1}$. The branching fractions are determined by measuring efficiency-corrected event yields relative to $B^+ \\to J/\\psi K^+$ decays (with $J/\\psi \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$), which results in the reduction of many of the systematic uncertainties. The decay $B_s^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ is observed with a significance of 5.6 standard deviations. No significant excess is observed for the decay $B^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$, and an upper limit of $\\mathcal{B}(B^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-) < 3.6 \\times 10^{-10}$ is obtained at 95% confidence level. The $B_s^0 \\to \\mu^+ \\mu^-$ effective lifetime is measured, for the first time in CMS, and is found to be $\\tau_{\\mu^+\\mu^-} = 1.70^{+0.61}_{-0.44} \\pm 0.05$ ps.
